answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 36952 Country: Pakistan Title: Please tell me that when a person who is away from Madinah says 'Ya Rasul Allah', did he commit a shirk? I am very much confused about this issue Question: . I heard some people saying that it is alright to say so, while some say that it comes under shirk. Answer ID: 36952 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 436/287/D=1433) If someone says "Ya Rasul Allah" with the belief that the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) is omnipresent and omniscient and he listens to our calls and requests and fulfils our needs, so this is unlawful and shirk. But instead of the said belief, if someone pronounced "Ya Rasul Allah" sometime out of utmost love then it is allowable but it is better to avoid this word since it involves a doubt of shirk. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
